description.value: Jasper Way Inn is a family-owned lakeside resort and campground on Dutch Lake in Clearwater, BC, offering motel rooms, a cabin, and RV/tent sites with lake views. Situated close to Wells Gray Provincial Park, it serves as a scenic base for cyclists riding the Thompson-Clearwater corridor. Canoe, kayak, and paddleboard rentals are available on-site, and the property includes a private dock and lakeside BBQs and fire pits.

address.value: 57 Old North Thompson Highway Rd E #1, Clearwater, BC V0E 1N2
